message:
Yeah, I've been slacking on the Friday Non-Dissertational category. (But c'mon, the porn spam thing was fun, right?) Haven't felt terribly creative lately. I've got one really long and deeply flawed thing that I haven't posted because it's a fictionalized story about a racist soldier who I had in my squad, that could maybe stand some revision. But yeah, I'd like to get back to the Friday breaks.

As for multi-layer clothing: well, it was a New England winter, and I'm a child of the 80's. What can I say? :)

("He's a lumberjack, and he's OK / He sleeps all night and works all day / He. . .")
